assertions.name: standard-commit-route-points-to-codex
assertions.evidence: routing section: 'standard_commit: codex  # Basic stage + commit, Codex works fine'. Explicitly routes to Codex.

assertions.name: commit-path-uses-real-git-shell-commands
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'pre_commit_hooks: true  # Git triggers automatically'. Implies standard git shell commit commands. No nonexistent Codex-specific primitives used.

assertions.name: pre-commit-hooks-remain-supported
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'pre_commit_hooks: true  # Git triggers automatically'. Hook execution is a git capability preserved under Codex.

assertions.name: cr-review-gap-is-marked-conditional
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'cr_review: conditional  # Only if cr CLI installed in environment'. Not silently assumed.

assertions.name: manual-cr-shell-path-is-documented
assertions.evidence: gaps.codex_missing: 'cr_review_precheck: Run cr manually or skip; risk: bad commits pass'. The cr shell path is acknowledged.

assertions.name: codex-review-is-not-treated-as-coderabbit
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex tracks 'cr_review' (the CodeRabbit CLI) separately. No conflation with 'codex review' command. Routing 'cr_gated_commit: claude' sends CodeRabbit-dependent work to Claude.

assertions.name: ralph-mode-is-marked-unavailable
assertions.evidence: capabilities.yaml codex: 'ralph_mode: false  # No JSON story criterion marking'. Clearly unavailable.

assertions.name: claude-or-manual-story-update-fallback-exists
assertions.evidence: routing: 'ralph_atomic_commit: claude'. gaps.codex_missing: 'ralph_mode: Must be done in Claude session'. Both routing and gap documentation provide the fallback.

assertions.name: standard-and-ralph-routes-do-not-collapse
assertions.evidence: routing has distinct entries: 'standard_commit: codex' and 'ralph_atomic_commit: claude'. Two separate paths, no overlap.
